name: Shukujo no Kokuhaku ~Hounyuu Jukuzuma, Hakuchuu no Mikkai
original_name: 淑女の告白 ～豊乳熟妻、白昼の蜜会
source:
Yukino, whose husband is a university professor, has a sexual relationship with her husband's student, Yuto.
Yuto is more than 10 years younger than her husband... her sexually frustrated body caught a fire with Yuto's aggressive sexual desire.
Even knowing it is not a good thing, Yukino can no stop meeting him... What ending awaits her...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047070.html]DLsite English[/url]]
